# A package func writing a package var that a component built at run time
# reads -- in a branch of its own and in an effect's key -- reaches the
# instance, on every target, as a handler's write and a test's do.
#
# A build rooted at a component filed that root's instances under it as well
# as under the page, so the page's refresh never reached them, and the func,
# which may run anywhere, re-fired the instance's render slot by a name only
# the instance has: "__renderSlot0 is not defined" on html, "undefined:
# __renderSlot0" on fyne. And android ran the call straight from the test,
# not on the UI thread with a wait after it, so the effect keyed on what it
# wrote had not run when the next assertion read it. And an effect under the
# instance's own `if dex != null` is keyed on that condition as well as on its
# `on`: the condition read the var itself, so the func settled the instance's
# effects by name too, "__effects0_settle is not defined".

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var dex option[string] = "national"
var resets = 0
var mounts = 0

func choose(name option[string]) {
    dex = name
}

component page ui.node {
    var seen = 0
    effect(on=dex, @update {
        resets += 1
        seen = resets
    })
    ui.text(value="{seen}")
    if dex != null {
        effect(on=dex, @mount(d) { mounts += 1 })
        ui.text(value=dex)
    }
}

component back ui.node {
    var away = false
    ui.button #leave(text="Leave", @click { away = !away })
    ui.button #pick(text="Kanto", @click { dex = "kanto" })
    if !away {
        page #page
    }
}

func testAWriteThroughAFuncReachesThePage(t test.Test, c back) {
    var before = resets
    choose("kanto")
    t.assert(dex == "kanto")
    t.assert(resets == before + 1)
}

func testAWriteThroughAFuncRemountsTheBranchsEffect(t test.Test, c back) {
    var before = mounts
    choose("hoenn")
    t.assert(mounts == before + 1)
    choose(null)
    choose("sinnoh")
    t.assert(mounts == before + 2)
}

func testAHandlersWriteReachesThePage(t test.Test, c back) {
    var before = resets
    c.pick.click()
    t.assert(resets == before + 1)
}

func testATestsWriteReachesThePage(t test.Test, c back) {
    var before = resets
    dex = "johto"
    t.assert(resets == before + 1)
}
